environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API) with Lambda proxy integration. The Lambda execution role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ProfileServiceRole) has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/DynamoDBLeadingKeyBoundary) attached that includes a Deny statement with condition key 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' using ForAllValues:StringEquals against '${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}'. The role's session tags are populated via STS AssumeRole from the deployment pipeline with tenant_id derived from the API Gateway stage variable. Additionally, the DynamoDB table 'Resources' has a resource-based policy fragment (via AWS::DynamoDB::Table policy in CloudFormation) that restricts UpdateItem to requests where the ExpressionAttributeValues contain a ':currentOwner' matching the caller's principal tag. The API Gateway stage has a method-level throttling of 1 req/sec on POST /profile/transfer-ownership. Cookie SameSite is 'None' with Secure flag.

role_session_tags.tenant_id: derived from API Gateway stage variable at deploy time

config.table_resource_policy: Restricts UpdateItem on Resources table - ExpressionAttributeValues ':currentOwner' must match aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id
